name: reference vehicle - simulator model parameters
role: simulator modelling choices and firmware givens that are NOT in the reference-vehicle digest (spec_values.json). Geometry, mass properties, thruster layout and sensor poses always come from the digest; this file only holds dynamics parameters of the actuators, the battery, the hotel load and the collision / servo settings.

camera_tilt.note: servo: position actuator on the tilt hinge; the commanded angle is slewed at rate_deg_s (servo speed estimate)

gripper.note: 1 DOF: the two jaws turn about their own pins and are coupled by an equality constraint (pusher linkage); one position actuator drives the upper jaw. Torque limit = 2 x official grip force at the calibration point x its lever arm about the pin. close_open_s null = take the official open / close time from the digest. Pads: one box per jaw on its gripping face (the CAD jaw's convex hull is not a gripping surface: the closed jaws' hulls overlap).

collision.note: vehicle collision geoms: contype 2 / conaffinity 1 (collide with ordinary geoms, not with each other)
